Type: two-seat sofa bed on wheels
Use: seating, sleeping guests; living room, guest room, studio, kids room
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: white fabric cover over a foam mattress, white powder-coated steel frame, grey wheels
Colors: bright white, light grey wheels
Shape: armless folding frame, back that folds down into a bed, two loose lumbar cushions, large wheels at the front, light and open
Feel: fresh, practical, airy
Goes with: white walls, light wood, bright accents; small apartments, Scandinavian or modern guest rooms

product.name: IKEA PS LVS
product.description: Extra covers to alternate with mean it's easy to give both your sofa and room a new look.
